label: create-traceharbor-namespace
sql: CREATE NAMESPACE IF NOT EXISTS lightning.metastore.traceharbor

label: compile-usl
sql:
COMPILE USL shipment_evidence DEPLOY NAMESPACE lightning.metastore.traceharbor DDL
CREATE TABLE manifest (
  row_id varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  shipment_id varchar(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  consignee varchar(200),
  route varchar(200),
  origin varchar(100),
  destination varchar(100),
  cargo_label varchar(200),
  primary_sensor_id varchar(64),
  min_temp_c double,
  max_temp_c double,
  investigation_window_start varchar(64),
  investigation_window_end varchar(64),
  expected_interval_minutes int,
  promised_at varchar(64),
  reported_status varchar(64),
  reported_status_at varchar(64),
  source_updated_at varchar(64)
);
CREATE TABLE telemetry (
  row_id varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  reading_id varchar(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  shipment_id varchar(64) NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES manifest(shipment_id),
  sensor_id varchar(64),
  observed_at varchar(64),
  temperature_c double,
  reading_quality varchar(64),
  source_updated_at varchar(64)
);
CREATE TABLE incidents (
  row_id varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  incident_id varchar(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  shipment_id varchar(64) NOT NULL FOREIGN KEY REFERENCES manifest(shipment_id),
  occurred_at varchar(64),
  event_type varchar(100),
  reported_status varchar(64),
  details varchar(2000),
  source_updated_at varchar(64)
);
CREATE TABLE calibration (
  row_id varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  calibration_id varchar(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  sensor_id varchar(64),
  valid_from varchar(64),
  valid_to varchar(64),
  offset_c double,
  status varchar(64),
  reference_method varchar(500),
  confirmed_at varchar(64),
  source_updated_at varchar(64)
)

label: activate-manifest
sql:
ACTIVATE USL TABLE lightning.metastore.traceharbor.shipment_evidence.manifest AS
SELECT COALESCE(CAST(r.row_id AS STRING), '') AS row_id,
  COALESCE(CAST(r.shipment_id AS STRING), '') AS shipment_id,
  CAST(r.consignee AS STRING) AS consignee,
  CAST(r.route AS STRING) AS route,
  CAST(r.origin AS STRING) AS origin,
  CAST(r.destination AS STRING) AS destination,
  CAST(r.cargo_label AS STRING) AS cargo_label,
  CAST(r.primary_sensor_id AS STRING) AS primary_sensor_id,
  CAST(r.min_temp_c AS DOUBLE) AS min_temp_c,
  CAST(r.max_temp_c AS DOUBLE) AS max_temp_c,
  CAST(r.investigation_window_start AS STRING) AS investigation_window_start,
  CAST(r.investigation_window_end AS STRING) AS investigation_window_end,
  CAST(r.expected_interval_minutes AS INT) AS expected_interval_minutes,
  CAST(r.promised_at AS STRING) AS promised_at,
  CAST(r.reported_status AS STRING) AS reported_status,
  CAST(r.reported_status_at AS STRING) AS reported_status_at,
  CAST(r.source_updated_at AS STRING) AS source_updated_at
FROM traceharbor_sources.manifest_raw LATERAL VIEW explode(records) AS r

row_id <> '' AND reading_id <> '' AND shipment_id <> ''
AND sensor_id IS NOT NULL AND sensor_id <> ''
AND observed_at IS NOT NULL AND observed_at <> ''
AND temperature_c IS NOT NULL AND temperature_c >= -80 AND temperature_c <= 80

label: usl-calibrated-observations
sql:
SELECT m.shipment_id, m.row_id AS manifest_row_id, t.row_id AS telemetry_row_id,
  t.reading_id, t.sensor_id, t.observed_at, t.temperature_c,
  c.row_id AS calibration_row_id, c.calibration_id, c.offset_c,
  CASE WHEN c.calibration_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.temperature_c - c.offset_c
    ELSE NULL END AS corrected_temperature_c,
  m.min_temp_c, m.max_temp_c
FROM lightning.metastore.traceharbor.shipment_evidence.manifest m
JOIN lightning.metastore.traceharbor.shipment_evidence.telemetry t
  ON m.shipment_id = t.shipment_id
LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.traceharbor.shipment_evidence.calibration c
  ON t.sensor_id = c.sensor_id AND c.status = 'confirmed'
  AND c.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND c.confirmed_at <> ''
  AND t.observed_at >= c.valid_from AND t.observed_at < c.valid_to
WHERE t.temperature_c BETWEEN -80 AND 80
  AND t.observed_at >= m.investigation_window_start
  AND t.observed_at <= m.investigation_window_end
ORDER BY m.shipment_id, t.observed_at

label: usl-event-context
sql:
SELECT m.shipment_id, m.reported_status AS manifest_status,
  t.row_id AS telemetry_row_id, t.observed_at, t.temperature_c,
  i.row_id AS incident_row_id, i.occurred_at, i.event_type,
  i.reported_status AS event_status, i.details
FROM lightning.metastore.traceharbor.shipment_evidence.manifest m
LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.traceharbor.shipment_evidence.telemetry t
  ON m.shipment_id = t.shipment_id
LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.traceharbor.shipment_evidence.incidents i
  ON m.shipment_id = i.shipment_id
ORDER BY m.shipment_id, t.observed_at, i.occurred_at

label: usl-primary-observation-coverage
sql:
SELECT m.shipment_id, m.investigation_window_start, m.investigation_window_end,
  m.expected_interval_minutes, COUNT(DISTINCT t.observed_at) AS valid_primary_observations
FROM lightning.metastore.traceharbor.shipment_evidence.manifest m
LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.traceharbor.shipment_evidence.telemetry t
  ON m.shipment_id = t.shipment_id AND m.primary_sensor_id = t.sensor_id
  AND t.temperature_c BETWEEN -80 AND 80 AND t.reading_id <> ''
  AND t.observed_at >= m.investigation_window_start
  AND t.observed_at <= m.investigation_window_end
GROUP BY m.shipment_id, m.investigation_window_start, m.investigation_window_end,
  m.expected_interval_minutes
ORDER BY m.shipment_id
